entries.dialogueText: “Anton! Finally! Now the real party can start. Come on in!”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, Petr. What's next? A choir? A marching band?”
entries.menuText: “Thank you, Petr. What's next? A choir? A marching band?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Far from becoming accustomed to my..."
entries.dialogueText: Far from becoming accustomed to my workload as president, I only felt more and more snowed under as the weeks passed. It had been ages since I had any time to myself.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I gestured at one of the waitresses..."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured at one of the waitresses to come over.
entries.menuText: Gesture at one of the waitresses to come over.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was starting to lose my focus, an..."
entries.dialogueText: I was starting to lose my focus, and my temper was growing increasingly thin. Petr was the first to realize I needed a break.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After much cajoling, he finally per..."
entries.dialogueText: After much cajoling, he finally persuaded me to come to a meeting of his new venture: Gentlemen's Club.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For the past few months, he'd been..."
entries.dialogueText: For the past few months, he'd been hosting a salon of sorts, not just for politicians and businessmen but also for artists, entertainers -- people of taste, he told me with a smile on his face.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was only one rule: no wives o..."
entries.dialogueText: There was only one rule: no wives or girlfriends allowed. Hence the name.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And so I found myself in front of h..."
entries.dialogueText: And so I found myself in front of his new luxury villa in Erlory. Very loud jazz music emanated from inside. I waited and waited. Finally Petr opened the door. I could smell the whiskey on his breath.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We walked through the corridors of..."
entries.dialogueText: We walked through the corridors of his mansion. Statues and paintings lined the stark white walls. An arched window provided a view of the neatly manicured grounds, complete with a swimming pool.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Gentlemen! A minute of your time p..."
entries.dialogueText: “Gentlemen! A minute of your time please.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As soon as I entered, Petr closed t..."
entries.dialogueText: As soon as I entered, Petr closed the door and turned to the small crowd.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I now have the privilege to presen..."
entries.dialogueText: “I now have the privilege to present to you... The man himself... The fourth President of Sordland, Mr. Anton Rayne!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I'd known him for long enough to un..."
entries.dialogueText: I'd known him for long enough to understand that he was more than a little drunk. He made an elaborate mock-curtsy as I passed him and walked into the room. The music stopped, and I felt everyone's eyes on me.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“And I present to you, Petr Vectern..."
entries.dialogueText: “And I present to you, Petr Vectern. The first alcoholic Vice President of Sordland.”
entries.menuText: “And I present to you, Petr Vectern. The first alcoholic Vice President of Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good evening.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good evening.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My joke didn't sit well with Petr,..."
entries.dialogueText: My joke didn't sit well with Petr, nor the crowd. There was a short awkward silence before he continued.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“No. I'm saving those for your fune..."
entries.dialogueText: “No. I'm saving those for your funeral."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr laughed very hard at his own g..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr laughed very hard at his own grim joke before continuing.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Dear members, please give a warm w..."
entries.dialogueText: “Dear members, please give a warm welcome to our very special guest! If I may, Anton. Here, take this.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He handed me a glass of whiskey and..."
entries.dialogueText: He handed me a glass of whiskey and put his hand on my shoulder.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Let me show you around.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let me show you around.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr nodded at me and turned to the..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr nodded at me and turned to the attendees.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Anton Rayne might have the power t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Anton Rayne might have the power to make presidential decrees, but, I, Petr Vectern, the president of this club, now declare this party started! Music! Go!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The band started up again."
entries.dialogueText: The band started up again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After greeting the crowd around me,..."
entries.dialogueText: After greeting the crowd around me, I felt a hand on my shoulder.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“That chandelier was made in the 18..."
entries.dialogueText: “That chandelier was made in the 18th century. Can you believe it? There's even a hedge maze in the garden!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What's the story behind the chande..."
entries.dialogueText: “What's the story behind the chandelier?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“How are you paying for all of this..."
entries.dialogueText: “How are you paying for all of this?”
entries.menuText: “How are you paying for all of this?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“An 18th-century chandelier? A hedg..."
entries.dialogueText: “An 18th-century chandelier? A hedge maze? A little much, isn't it?”
entries.menuText: “An 18th-century chandelier? A hedge maze? A little much, isn't it?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A grand Lespian marble staircase le..."
entries.dialogueText: A grand Lespian marble staircase led up to the second story. Petr gestured at the massive crystal chandelier hanging overhead.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I don't know and I don't care. It..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't know and I don't care. It just looks expensive and I like it.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I'll let you in on a secret. Gus M..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'll let you in on a secret. Gus Manger has a lot of contacts in real estate. He brokered an amazing price for me.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Ah, come on, Anton. You only live..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ah, come on, Anton. You only live once.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“He'll also be here tonight, by the..."
entries.dialogueText: “He'll also be here tonight, by the way."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What did you promise him in return?""
entries.dialogueText: "What did you promise him in return?"
entries.menuText: "What did you promise him in return?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Perfect. I've been looking for a c..."
entries.dialogueText: “Perfect. I've been looking for a chance to speak with him about investment opportunities."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Only my money.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Only my money.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We continued walking until we circl..."
entries.dialogueText: We continued walking until we circled back to where we had started.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“So, what do you think of my little..."
entries.dialogueText: “So, what do you think of my little hideaway?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Not bad. Not bad at all.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Not bad. Not bad at all.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Living a lavish lifestyle while my..."
entries.dialogueText: “Living a lavish lifestyle while my country suffers is not for me.”
entries.menuText: “Living in a lavish mansion while my country suffers is not for me.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I understand completely. That's wh..."
entries.dialogueText: “I understand completely. That's why I've donated 30 percent of my vice presidential salary to charities."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Frankly, I find it disgusting.""
entries.dialogueText: “Frankly, I find it disgusting."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's amazing, but I'd hardly call..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's amazing, but I'd hardly call it a hideaway. More like a palace.”
entries.menuText: “It's amazing, but I'd hardly call it a hideaway. More like a palace.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Jealous, are we? Like I said, you..."
entries.dialogueText: “Jealous, are we? Like I said, you could have a place just like this.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“It definitely doesn't rival yours...."
entries.dialogueText: “It definitely doesn't rival yours.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Thanks! You know that you, Monica..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thanks! You know that you, Monica and the kids are always welcome here.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Anyway, let's get back to the part..."
entries.dialogueText: “Anyway, let's get back to the party.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I arranged for some caviar to be b..."
entries.dialogueText: “I arranged for some caviar to be brought in from Lespia. You're going to love it.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He opened the door to the main hall..."
entries.dialogueText: He opened the door to the main hall, and we rejoined the other guests. The music was louder now, and the mood decidedly more inebriated.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Cocktail waitresses were carrying a..."
entries.dialogueText: Cocktail waitresses were carrying around plates of canapés, wearing dresses that left little to the imagination.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She was in her mid-twenties, wearin..."
entries.dialogueText: She was in her mid-twenties, wearing red lipstick, her blonde hair neatly tied into a ponytail. On her plate were toast points slathered in the Lespian caviar Petr had mentioned.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I thought this was a *Gentlemen*'s..."
entries.dialogueText: “I thought this was a *Gentlemen*'s Club.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“So this is what you've been hiding..."
entries.dialogueText: “So this is what you've been hiding from Evelyn.”
entries.menuText: “So this is what you've been hiding from Evelyn.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Lespian caviar, best in the world!..."
entries.dialogueText: “Lespian caviar, best in the world! I'm telling you, Anton, there are few pleasures in life that are this..."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“No one is hiding anything. She kno..."
entries.dialogueText: “No one is hiding anything. She knows how important it is for men like us to blow off steam once in a while."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He averted his gaze for a second be..."
entries.dialogueText: He averted his gaze for a second before calling over one of the waitresses.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Would you rather get served by wri..."
entries.dialogueText: “Would you rather get served by wrinkly old men? Sweetheart! Over here!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He waved at one of the waitresses,..."
entries.dialogueText: He waved at one of the waitresses, and she came over to us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the waitress left us to serve an..."
entries.dialogueText: As the waitress left us to serve another attendee, she flashed a quick smile at Petr over her shoulder. He smiled back, a little too broadly.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Oh look, there's Gus. Why don't yo..."
entries.dialogueText: “Oh look, there's Gus. Why don't you go talk to him? I'll be back in a minute.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Petr. I am warning you. Don't make..."
entries.dialogueText: “Petr. I am warning you. Don't make a mistake.”
entries.menuText: “Petr. I am warning you. Don't make a mistake.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Where are you going?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Where are you going?”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Mistake? What are you talking abou..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mistake? What are you talking about? I'm just going to the... washroom. See you shortly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He left the room and I headed over..."
entries.dialogueText: He left the room and I headed over to Gus.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gus Manger was standing next to a c..."
entries.dialogueText: Gus Manger was standing next to a couple of men that I recognized as banking industry magnates. As I approached, all of them turned to me and bowed their heads.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Mr. President. A toast to our new..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. A toast to our new member, everyone!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gus and I clinked our glasses as th..."
entries.dialogueText: Gus and I clinked our glasses as the people around us raised theirs.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You don't seem at all surprised to..."
entries.dialogueText: “You don't seem at all surprised to see me here.”
entries.menuText: “You don't seem at all surprised to see me here.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“How long have you been a member?”"
entries.dialogueText: “How long have you been a member?”
entries.menuText: “How long have you been a member?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I heard this mansion is a result o..."
entries.dialogueText: “I heard this mansion is a result of your connections.”
entries.menuText: “I heard this mansion is a result of your connections.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“That's right. I do have a wide net..."
entries.dialogueText: “That's right. I do have a wide network in real estate.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“We all know why we're gathered her..."
entries.dialogueText: “We all know why we're gathered here tonight. To celebrate life. To have a brief escape from our tumultuous professions.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I personally don't know any better..."
entries.dialogueText: “I personally don't know any better cure for stress than a little drink.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Now. The tradition dictates that a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Now. The tradition dictates that as the club president, I have to remind you of our house rules. There are three. No politics. No wives. No one sober! Cheers!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr drank the whiskey in his glass..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr drank the whiskey in his glass in one go.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Only a little one?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Only a little one?”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I raised my glass and the rest of t..."
entries.dialogueText: I raised my glass and the rest of the crowd followed.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'll drink to that!”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'll drink to that!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few people in the crowd chuckled..."
entries.dialogueText: A few people in the crowd chuckled and some raised their glasses.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "People in the crowd laughed and rai..."
entries.dialogueText: People in the crowd laughed and raised their glasses.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I followed suit and drained my glas..."
entries.dialogueText: I followed suit and drained my glass. It was immediately replenished.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I took a sip from my whiskey."
entries.dialogueText: I took a sip from my whiskey.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Since the beginning. It's a fun ga..."
entries.dialogueText: “Since the beginning. It's a fun gathering, and quite lucrative at times."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“That's because Petr told me you we..."
entries.dialogueText: “That's because Petr told me you were going to come.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“He also told me that you might be..."
entries.dialogueText: “He also told me that you might be interested in potential opportunities such as, well... this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He opened his arms, gesturing at ou..."
entries.dialogueText: He opened his arms, gesturing at our opulent surroundings.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“You might've heard from Petr that..."
entries.dialogueText: “You might've heard from Petr that I arranged the deal for this mansion.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Petr told me a couple of weeks ago..."
entries.dialogueText: “Petr told me a couple of weeks ago that you might be interested in potential opportunities such as, well... this.”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Let's take a walk. The balcony has..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's take a walk. The balcony has an amazing view of Erlory.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We left the room and made our way t..."
entries.dialogueText: We left the room and made our way to the balcony. On the way, he took out two cigars and held one out for me.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I took the cigar and started smokin..."
entries.dialogueText: I took the cigar and started smoking it. Mixed with the taste of whiskey, it was delicious.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I turned the cigar down. Gus lit up..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned the cigar down. Gus lit up his own and started smoking.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We went out to the balcony. All of..."
entries.dialogueText: We went out to the balcony. All of Erlory was at our feet. From this vantage point, I was able to see how expansive the building plot was. The swimming pool and the hedge maze were visible from here.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leaning over the railing, I admired..."
entries.dialogueText: Leaning over the railing, I admired the view for a moment before Gus spoke up.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Real estate is the best investment..."
entries.dialogueText: “Real estate is the best investment anyone can make. With the current economic situation, it only makes sense to put your money into such a tangible asset."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“But I also have a few other opport..."
entries.dialogueText: “But I also have a few other opportunities for you to make a side profit, if real estate doesn't interest you."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Is there any chance I can convince..."
entries.dialogueText: “Is there any chance I can convince you?”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I would be delighted to discuss a..."
entries.dialogueText: “I would be delighted to discuss a similar arrangement with you. In fact, I have prepared a document with my own personal favorite opportunities.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“He'll have a once-in-a-lifetime de..."
entries.dialogueText: “He'll have a once-in-a-lifetime deal ready for you. He always does."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “I thought as much.”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “I understand.”

entries.title: Gus Manger: "“It's unfortunate.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's unfortunate.”

entries.dialogueText: “I have already made my investment. Unfortunately, I have yet to see a return."

entries.title: Gus Manger: "“I know you're wondering about the..."

entries.dialogueText: “Cheers to investments paying off, then.”

entries.dialogueText: He downed his whiskey.

entries.title: Gus Manger: "“No, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No, Mr. President.”

entries.dialogueText: “No. That's my final answer.”

entries.title: Gus Manger: ""There's also the option of a footb..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's also the option of a football partnership. I already own a large portion of FC Anrica, and I'm doing my best to make them champions. Buying in would be more expensive than the vineyard, but this season will bring a lot of returns, I'm quite positive."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“My biggest opportunity, though, is..."
entries.dialogueText: “My biggest opportunity, though, is the possibility to buy shares in Underhall Construction. My connections ensured me that this would not be open to the public and would benefit you greatly. As you know, they are the biggest construction company in Sordland...”

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""My first offer is, of course, real..."
entries.dialogueText: "My first offer is, of course, real estate. There is a vineyard close to Erlory, about a one-hour drive from here, that also includes a very large villa. A beautiful plot, but rather neglected, so there would be a fair amount of renovation costs. On the bright side, you would be able to produce your own wine. The previous owner was Giralt of Ribery, a world-renowned vintner."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“Give me the word, and I will start..."
entries.dialogueText: “Give me the word, and I will start the procurement process. But we must act quickly as these options might soon disappear off the market.”

entries.dialogueText: I looked down and saw a silhouette. Two silhouettes, actually, so close together they seemed to be entangled. I squinted and tried to get a better look. It was definitely two people kissing, but I couldn't see either of their faces.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I returned to the party and spent s..."
entries.dialogueText: I returned to the party and spent some time mingling with the other guests, engaging them in small talk about their businesses, their children, their relationships.

entries.dialogueText: Just then, Petr came up from behind us and threw an arm around each of our shoulders.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He poured us two large glasses of w..."
entries.dialogueText: He poured us two large glasses of whiskey, and we drank them in one go. Throughout the party, we drank and drank. Just like old times.

entries.title: Narrator: "I woke up the next day with a pound..."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: I took a bite. It was rich, salty, tasting of pure seaside. I could almost hear the sound of waves and seagulls.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No politics, remember?""
entries.dialogueText: "No politics, remember?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Terrific. I'm looking forward to a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Terrific. I'm looking forward to a big payoff."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm glad that Sordland could help..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad that Sordland could help your company thrive."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Enjoy our bailout, Mr. Alphonso. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enjoy our bailout, Mr. Alphonso. It'll be your only one."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And you, of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "And you, of course."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I still stand by my decision. Ther..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still stand by my decision. There were better uses for that money."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, perhaps Sordland should've in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, perhaps Sordland should've invested. But it's too late for regrets."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm sorry about that. My party for..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry about that. My party forced me to do it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Unlike you, I know better than to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unlike you, I know better than to mess with a successful Tarquin Soll policy."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I know how much pressure the USP c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know how much pressure the USP can exert. But I also know that with a little courage, resistance is possible."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It seems your courage failed you...."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems your courage failed you. And you, in turn, have failed Gasom."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""That policy put a chokehold on Sor..."
entries.dialogueText: "That policy put a chokehold on Sordish businesses. Thanks to you, it is doing so again."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""That goes without saying.""
entries.dialogueText: "That goes without saying."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Better uses, maybe. But not more p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Better uses, maybe. But not more profitable ones."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It's not too late to remember to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not too late to remember to take more risks in the future."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sighed."
entries.dialogueText: He sighed.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""No politics. But this conversation..."
entries.dialogueText: "No politics. But this conversation is not over."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""As I've told you, this isn't a bai..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I've told you, this isn't a bailout. You'll get your money back and then some."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""And vice versa.""
entries.dialogueText: "And vice versa."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I can't tell you for sure how big..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't tell you for sure how big it will be. But our projections are looking good."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Look at you two! Sordland's bright..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at you two! Sordland's bright future and its ancient, ancient past."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Petr. Behave yourself.""
entries.dialogueText: "Petr. Behave yourself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's been an hour. Where were you?""
entries.dialogueText: "It's been an hour. Where were you?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""My apologies, Mr. Alphonso. My vic..."
entries.dialogueText: "My apologies, Mr. Alphonso. My vice president's had a bit too much to drink."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Another brilliant zinger, Petr.""
entries.dialogueText: "Another brilliant zinger, Petr."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I told you. The washroom. Trust me..."
entries.dialogueText: "I told you. The washroom. Trust me, you'd rather not know the details."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That's what I'm here for.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's what I'm here for."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Pardon me, Mr. President, but I've..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pardon me, Mr. President, but I've had exactly enough."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yes, Mr. President. Right away, Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Mr. President. Right away, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Well, Mr. Alphonso? Have you been..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Mr. Alphonso? Have you been enjoying my hospitality?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alphonso smiled politely."
entries.dialogueText: Alphonso smiled politely.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Indeed I have, Mr. Vectern. You've..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed I have, Mr. Vectern. You've put together one hell of a gathering."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""If you'll excuse me, I'm going to..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you'll excuse me, I'm going to have a quick word with the CEO of Sordish Petroleum."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He's here, too? What a party.""
entries.dialogueText: "He's here, too? What a party."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Have fun mingling. It was good to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have fun mingling. It was good to see you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We'll talk soon.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll talk soon."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alphonso gave a brusque wave and wa..."
entries.dialogueText: Alphonso gave a brusque wave and walked off.

entries.speaker: Player

entries.speaker: Player

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will give you one more chance. W..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will give you one more chance. Where were you?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I didn't know! Gus brought him alo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't know! Gus brought him along. And when a former president of Sordland knocks on your door, you can't exactly turn him away."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr assumed a patient look."
entries.dialogueText: Petr assumed a patient look.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Well, Mr. President, when too much..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Mr. President, when too much Sordish whiskey meets too much Lespian caviar, it can lead to a gastrointestinal imbroglio the likes of which the world has never seen."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""What are you talking about?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are you talking about?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""While you were gone, I saw two peo..."
entries.dialogueText: "While you were gone, I saw two people kissing in the hedge maze outside."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll be direct. Were you with the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be direct. Were you with the waitress?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You know what? Never mind. Let's g..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know what? Never mind. Let's get another drink."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Next time, I want to be able to ve..."
entries.dialogueText: "Next time, I want to be able to vet your guest list. You're risking a breach of national security with these parties."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's fine. I was happy to see him...."
entries.dialogueText: "It's fine. I was happy to see him. But it was definitely a surprise."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Anton. Can't a man have some fun o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anton. Can't a man have some fun outside of work?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Now you're speaking my language.""
entries.dialogueText: "Now you're speaking my language."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That's what I'm aiming for with th..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's what I'm aiming for with these parties. All kinds of unexpected, stimulating encounters."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""What? No, no. How could you even t..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? No, no. How could you even think that? I'm a married man."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Huh. Probably a couple of kitchen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Huh. Probably a couple of kitchen staff getting frisky with each other. What do I even pay them for?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""All right. If you say so.""
entries.dialogueText: "All right. If you say so."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Petr. You know you can tell me any..."
entries.dialogueText: "Petr. You know you can tell me anything."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""But sure. If it'll make you happy,..."
entries.dialogueText: "But sure. If it'll make you happy, I'll tighten my villa's border control policy."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He contorted the side of his face i..."
entries.dialogueText: He contorted the side of his face in an attempt at a wink.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Now who wants a drink? Besides me,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now who wants a drink? Besides me, of course."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I thought I saw his cheerful expres..."
entries.dialogueText: I thought I saw his cheerful expression slip for a moment.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yeah. I know. Trust me, it's nothi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah. I know. Trust me, it's nothing."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I do say so.""
entries.dialogueText: "I do say so."
